profile.headline: Data Warehouse Software Engineer at Paychex
profile.summary:
Engineer with experience on multi-disciplinary teams, with significant experience in software and hardware testing. Experience with white box and black box testing, test plan and test case creation, use cases, and validation and release testing.

Advanced Certificates in Statistical Methods and Statistical Quality. Graduate coursework in biostatistics. Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.

Extensive computer experience across multiple platforms and applications, including Minitab, SAS, R, Excel, Access, SQL, Assembler, Quality Center, Microsoft Office, and online software such as Google Docs and Content Management Sysems.

Troubleshooting and problem solving in manufacturing and computer system settings. Manufacturing experience in both professional and line worker capacity.

Specialties: Software QA, project management and planning, applied statistics, problem solving, process development, software applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer III - Data Quality Test Automation
positions.description: Test and process automation using Python and PL/SQL

positions.title: Software Engineer II - Data Quality Test Automation
Data Quality Analyst
positions.description:
Data quality testing of a mixed near-real-time and weekly load ETL (Extract, Transform, and Load) system used for customer reporting. Testing includes Oracle to Oracle data transformations, SQL Server to Oracle data transformations, and SQL Server applications.

Design and development of a data test framework used for both automated and ad hoc manual testing. The framework resides on the database and uses functions, stored procedures, and queries to test both initial and incremental loads.

Process documentation, and training/cross-training peers and new hires. Led ODI 12c upgrade test effort.

Tools and Technologies include:
- ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) 11g and 12c
- TOAD
- Delphix VDB
- BitBucket and Git Extensions
- Aginity
- SQL Server
- BCP and SQL*Loader
- Netezza
- SQL and PL/SQL
- Ranorex and Selenium

Prior responsibilities included testing and cross-training in ETL development for a traditional multi-source data warehouse used for internal reporting.

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description: (Contract) Testing payroll and reporting applications, including OBI and custom developed solutions.

positions.title: Board of Directors
positions.description:
NWMAF's mission is "To promote the involvement of women and girls in the martial arts." I served in multiple roles, including Secretary, Treasurer, and Events Coordinator. 

I also provided support to all things computer related in the federation's business, from setting up and migrating the online membership database to setting up email access on volunteers' computers by using TeamViewer.

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description: (Contract) Joined an existing team performing implementation testing of new and existing payroll applications. Verified that software met specification and validated releases.

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description: First instructor of project management at the American University in Kosovo. Adapted course design to meet the needs of the international student body.

positions.title: Software Tester
positions.description: (Contract) Part of a new software test team focused on web client testing of sales and service support software. Involved in creation of necessary test environments while working on multiple projects.

positions.title: Capstone Project
positions.description: As part of Master’s degree capstone project, designed IT Dashboard with actionable metrics by analyzing current operations and business needs. Managed project from proposal through on-time delivery of prototype.

positions.title: Software Test
positions.description: (Contract) Joined an existing team (iServe) testing financial web reports, following existing processes on a well-established release cycle. After department-wide cutbacks manager assisted my move to a new team (Voyager II) developing new international telcom call center application using Agile methodology.

positions.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
positions.description: Hired to implement IEEE Software Design and Test standards and be the in-house subject matter expert on HVAC control logic development. Worked on a cross-functional team that that developed a programmable logic controller that is now being used for new and existing HVAC systems.

positions.title: Software QA Engineer
positions.description: As a self-starter I was the first member of a new team responsible for testing telcom trouble ticket software (Clarify ClearSupport), and became a subject matter expert. Established processes and documentation to tame a chaotic, fast-paced, ad hoc oriented project team. QA Team Lead for successful conversion, upgrade, and migration projects.

positions.title: Software QA and Data Developer
positions.description: (Contract) Joined a large, process oriented development and test team (Service Choice) working on service support and trouble ticketing software.

positions.title: Technical Analyst/Writer
positions.description: (Contract) Joined a new team (DocuColor 40) responsible for creating repair procedures for Xerox’s first high speed sheet fed color copier. Joined additional teams supporting workcenter products (Regal, Majestik, Empress). Developed training and Train the Trainer materials in addition to repair manuals.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Concentrations in Applied Statistics and Data Analysis

honors.title: Paychex Contractor Award
honors.description:
This award recognizes a contractor's exceptional service to their clients/customers.

The nominee benefits Paychex and has a profound effect on others because he or she:
- produces consistent, quality results 
- contributes to a positive work environment 
- provides extraordinary customer service to internal and external customers 
- puts forth extra effort that deserves public recognition
